title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Payment Table — Number of Takeover Installments
content:
**Cascade Ortho Rider takeover cases: how many installments the takeover benefit is spread over.** For the member's repayment, the number of takeover installments follows the treatment left.

| Months remaining on the takeover entry | Schedule | Takeover installments |
|---|---|---|
| no more than the lump-sum months (6 on every rider) | any | a single payment |
| more than 6 | quarterly | the months remaining that fall within the installment months cap counted from the month after the banding month, divided by three and rounded up, never fewer than one |
| more than 6 | monthly | this rule does not change the number |

**Months within the cap.** The months remaining that fall within the installment months cap counted from the month after the banding month are the lesser of:

- the months remaining; and
- the cap less the months after the banding month before coverage began, that is the cap less the planned treatment months plus the months remaining, never below zero.

| Rider | Schedule | Installment months cap |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | quarterly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | quarterly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | quarterly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | monthly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | monthly | 30 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | monthly | 30 |

*Hypothetical cases on a quarterly rider with a 24-month cap and 30 planned months:*

| Months remaining | Months after the banding month before coverage | Months within the cap | Installments |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | 8 | lesser of 22 and 16 is 16 | 16 divided by three, rounded up, is 6 |
| 13 | 17 | lesser of 13 and 7 is 7 | 3 |
| 5 | | | 1 (lump-sum) |
